about: Zachary J. Alinder is a top-rated attorney who practices law in San Francisco, California. Zachary Alinder focuses on Intellectual Property Litigation issues. Additionally, he also helps clients with legal issues in the following areas of law: Civil Litigation: Plaintiff, Civil Litigation: Defense and Intellectual Property.

Zachary Alinder received Super Lawyers designation for 2016 - 2026. He was selected for this honor subsequent to undergoing an evaluation of many different factors including peer recognition and professional achievement.
He became a licensed attorney in 2000. Before practicing law, he attended law school at University of California Berkeley School of Law and graduated in 2000.
